ig_caption:
Your AI agent has no brakes. 🔁

AI wrote this agent loop:
⚠️ while True: ask the model → call the tool → repeat
⚠️ the only exit is the model saying "done"

The tool goes down, the model keeps retrying, and every step is a paid LLM call. 200+ calls and counting.

The fix:
✅ a hard step limit (MAX_STEPS)
✅ stop after 3 errors in a row
✅ hand the task to a human

Same outage → 3 calls → clean handoff.

Share this with your AI team 🔁 and follow for more fixes like this.

yt_title: AI agent stuck in an infinite loop (and the fix) #aiagents
yt_description:
Demo: real agent-loop code with a scripted stand-in for the model, so the run is repeatable. The tool returns error 503 and the "model" keeps asking to retry.
- AI-style loop (while True, exit only when the model says done): 200+ calls and still going
- fix: MAX_STEPS, stop after 3 consecutive errors, hand off to a human; same outage → 3 calls, then a clean handoff

With a real model, every one of those steps is a billed LLM call.
